channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Lula rebate Trump e diz que não aceita classificar facções como terroristas
item.description: President Lula stated he does not accept the U.S. classification of the PCC and CV as terrorist organizations, reiterating his stance at an event in Rio de Janeiro. He emphasized the need for dialogue and international cooperation to resolve conflicts peacefully. Lula also criticized Trump's approach, rejecting policies that impact Brazil's sovereignty.

item.title: Governo do Distrito Federal aciona STF e diz que resistência de Lula a ajudar BRB é decisão política
item.description: The Government of the Federal District filed a lawsuit with the STF to challenge President Lula's statements regarding the BRB crisis, alleging that the federal government's reluctance to assist the institution has political motivation. The Public Prosecutor's Office of the DF argued that the president's stance is a political decision rather than a technical one. The case involves the relationship between powers and the management of public institutions.

item.title: Ronilso: Caneta emagrecedora no SUS pode ter apelo maior que Bolsa Família
item.description: Columnist Ronilso Pacheco evaluated that President Lula's promise to provide weight-loss pens through SUS may have greater popular appeal than the Bolsa Família adjustment. He noted the campaign strategy as a way to attract voters with health policies.

item.title: Nova Constituição e nova gestão: Senado moderno nasceu há 40 anos
item.description: The Brazilian Senate was modernized by the 1946 Constitution, restoring powers such as bill initiative and the return to three representatives per state. These reforms, marking the birth of the modern Senate, still shape the current functioning of the upper chamber.

item.title: Lula rebate Trump sobre classificação de facções e diz que terrorismo foi o 8 de Janeiro
item.description: President Lula rejected the US designation of the PCC and Red Command as terrorist organizations, arguing that true terrorism in Brazil was the January 8th coup attempt led by Jair Bolsonaro. He emphasized the need to fight organized crime but opposed equating criminal factions with terrorism, linking the concept to state terrorism. Lula is expected to address the issue during his speech at the UN General Assembly.

item.title: Presidente do PT admite impacto da crise do STF na campanha de Lula
item.description: PT leader Edinho Silva stated that the STF crisis hindered Lula's reelection campaign, amplifying anti-system sentiment. Disclosures of ties between justices and Daniel Vorcaro worsened institutional credibility concerns.

item.title: Por que PCC e CV são terroristas para os EUA, mas não para o Brasil; entenda
item.description: Lula rejects the US designation of PCC and CV as terrorist groups, arguing terrorism refers to the January 8th events, not criminal factions. Brazil distinguishes criminal organizations from terrorist groups based on motivation, focusing on material crimes rather than ideological ones.

item.title: Lula, Flávio Bolsonaro e Renan Santos vão a Santa Catarina no fim de semana a 15 dias do 1º turno
item.description: With 5.7 million voters, Santa Catarina is the main stage of the presidential campaign this weekend. Lula, Flávio Bolsonaro and Renan Santos hold events in Florianópolis, Joinville, Chapecó and Criciúma, intensifying outreach in the final stretch before the first round.

item.title: Ora, as contas públicas. O que importa é a economia da atenção
item.description: President Lula announced a Bolsa Família adjustment and the inclusion of weight-loss pens in SUS, measures with clear electoral bias that may face legal challenges for abuse of power. The article emphasizes the use of attention economy to shape the political narrative.

item.title: Secretário não vê risco de recuo na reforma tributária: “Ninguém é doido”
item.description: Brazil's tax reform will not be rolled back even if Lula loses the election, said Receita Federal chief Robinson Barreirinhas, noting that business groups and entities have stated no one intends to reverse the reform. He addressed criticism from Flávio Bolsonaro but emphasized sectoral support. The reform takes effect in 2027, with a projected 19% revenue increase for the government.

item.title: Zema lança jingle com o “ABC dos Intocáveis”
item.description: Romeu Zema released a satirical jingle titled 'ABC dos Intocáveis,' using AI to critique political figures such as Lula, Supreme Court justices, and businessmen linked to the Banco Master case. The video also touches on issues like data privacy and elite economic influence in Brazil. The release comes amid rising pre-election tensions.

item.title: Bancos investem em IA, mas maioria ainda está longe da maturidade para escalar
item.description: Despite high AI adoption among Brazilian banks, the average maturity score is only 2.29 out of 5, according to the MATH Group's diagnosis. Most companies (66%) are at the 'emergent' level, struggling to scale isolated initiatives into structured projects.

item.title: Lula rebate Trump sobre facções brasileiras e diz que Jair Bolsonaro fez terrorismo de Estado
item.description: Lula rebuffs Trump's stance on terrorism and criticizes the U.S. for labeling criminal factions like PCC and CV as terrorists, accusing Jair Bolsonaro of state terrorism for attempting a coup on January 8. He advocates for unified security forces to combat organized crime and jail faction leaders.

item.title: Ricardo Couto: “Hoje o estado do Rio de Janeiro saiu do vermelho”
item.description: Acting governor of Rio de Janeiro, Ricardo Couto, stated that the state has emerged from the red and is on track to accumulate R$ 5 billion in cash reserves, during an event alongside President Lula.

item.title: Renan Santos pede para TSE suspender aumento de pagamento do Bolsa Família feito por Lula
item.description: Renan Santos (Missão) asked the TSE to suspend the 15% increase in Bolsa Família announced by Lula, alleging electoral purpose. The lawsuit seeks to suspend payments from October 19 and requests a fine and Lula's disqualification if elected. The rapporteur is Minister André Mendonça.

item.title: Janja triplica engajamento nas redes e vídeos superarem 10 milhões de views
item.description: First Lady Janja Lula da Silva tripled her Instagram engagement between September 12 and 18, gaining over 32,000 new followers and reaching 3.05 million. Her videos exceeded 10 million views, with five posts reaching between 1 million and 3.3 million views each. The Ativaweb DataLab also highlighted an increase in female presence among her followers.

item.title: A conta do assistencialismo de Lula que chegará a 2027
item.description: The Lula government expanded social benefits in 2026, increasing pressure on public accounts with a 15.04% adjustment to Bolsa Família, raising it from R$ 600 to R$ 691, affecting the next government in 2027.

item.title: A nova pesquisa Quaest sobre Tarcísio x Haddad, a duas semanas da eleição em SP
item.description: Quaest will release a new polling survey for the São Paulo state government election, two weeks before the first round, featuring Tarcísio de Freitas and Fernando Haddad as the main candidates. The survey, consisting of 1.800 interviews with a two-point margin of error, will also update voting intentions for the presidency. In the previous poll, Tarcísio led with 42% against Haddad's 27%.

item.title: Análise de redes mostra explosão de menções ao STF, mas rejeição estável
item.description: The STF crisis led to a surge in social media mentions, peaking at 697K on September 17, but rejection rates remained stable (61-63%). Events like Fachin's decision suspension and pro-separate-case votes by Fux, Mendonça, and Cármen Lúcia boosted mentions and positive sentiment.

item.title: Governador da Califórnia assina decreto para criar um ‘interruptor de emergência’ contra IA
item.description: California Governor Gavin Newsom signed a decree to establish an 'emergency kill switch' for AI, following warnings about technology risks. The measure requires feasibility studies and independent audits within two months, amid federal inaction under Trump.

item.title: Flávio diz que Lula está “gagá” após fala sobre milicianos
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro labeled Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva as 'gagá' following the president's remarks linking a presidential candidate to Rio de Janeiro militia groups. During a speech, Flávio denied ties to militias and proposed classifying criminal factions as terrorist organizations. Lula had referenced the Bolsonaro family while questioning candidates connected to organized crime.

item.title: Lula promete canetas emagrecedoras no SUS; ‘vamos fazer de forma responsável’, diz Padilha
item.description: Lula promised to incorporate weight-loss injections into the SUS during an event with the Minister of Health, Padilha, who stated that medications will be provided free of charge after studies and a clinical protocol are defined. The measure aims to increase access to obesity treatment, with 14 medications already registered in Brazil.

item.title: “Não aceito a ideia de que as facções são terroristas”, diz Lula
item.description: President Lula (PT) rejected the classification of PCC and CV as terrorist organizations made by the Trump administration, stating that 'terrorism' was January 8th and the coup attempt. He emphasized that factions should not be linked to terrorism, reinforcing his stance against such designations.

item.title: Lula x Flávio Bolsonaro: a eleição pode ser decidida já no primeiro turno?
item.description: Lula leads with 43% against 39% for Flávio Bolsonaro in the latest Datafolha survey, with a margin of error of 2 points. To win in the first round, a candidate must exceed 50% of valid votes; Lula needs about 7 more points and Flávio, 11. The runoff vote from smaller candidates totaling 16% could determine the outcome.

item.title: Brasil tem menos de 50 especialistas em separar terras-raras, diz ANM
item.description: Brazil faces a critical shortage of specialists in rare earth element separation, with fewer than 50 experts nationwide, hindering progress in its critical minerals supply chain. Despite holding 25% of global reserves, the country remains heavily dependent on China for over 90% of processing, limiting its strategic and technological autonomy.

item.title: Na TV, Lula diz que preços “dispararam” durante o governo Bolsonaro
item.description: In his electoral ad, Lula claims food prices 'soared' during Bolsonaro's administration, citing specific increases like 45% in beans and rice. The ad uses Fipe data showing 57% price increases, but analysts note inflation was driven by external factors like the pandemic and Ukraine war, using different methodologies.

item.title: Lula reajustou Bolsa Família após reunião com mulheres e críticas a custo de vida na campanha
item.description: President Lula (PT) approved the adjustment of Bolsa Família after a meeting with a group of women who discussed the rising cost of life. The announcement comes amid criticism regarding inflation during his campaign.

item.title: Centrão admite bom momento de Flávio Bolsonaro, mas descarta embarque tardio
item.description: Centrão leaders acknowledge Flávio Bolsonaro's good momentum but rule out a late boost for his campaign. They maintain a cautious stance, viewing the electoral scenario as still undefined, and highlight Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's experience. The strategy aims to preserve relationships with potential winners without being labeled as dissidents.

item.title: Coordenador da campanha de Lula admite desgaste eleitoral após crise no STF
item.description: Edinho Silva, Lula's campaign coordinator, acknowledged electoral wear following the STF crisis but said the campaign responds with proposals like Judiciary reform. He rejected a direct link between PT judicial appointments and the court's wear, highlighting the legitimacy of social questioning toward the judiciary.

item.title: Lula e governo do RJ anunciam plano para retomar áreas sob domínio do crime
item.description: President Lula launched, in Rio de Janeiro, an integrated action plan with the state government aimed at retaking territories dominated by criminal organizations such as factions, militias, and the jogo do bicho.

item.title: Lula: experiência no RJ é um plano piloto, com as polícias trabalhando juntas para trazer paz
item.description: President Lula attended a ceremony in Rio de Janeiro to monitor integrated actions against organized crime. He emphasized that the experience in Rio is a pilot project with police forces working together to bring peace to the state.

item.title: Após crítica, Flávio diz que vai manter reajuste do Bolsa Família de Lula
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) stated he will keep the 15.04% increase in Bolsa Família if elected president, contradicting his earlier criticism of Lula's announcement. Despite initially calling the adjustment 'weak', Flávio pledged to maintain the social program.

item.title: Lula promete canetinhas no SUS mesmo após alerta de impacto de R$ 7 bilhões
item.description: President Lula promised to make weight-loss injections available through the SUS, disregarding government health committee warnings about a projected R$7 billion cost over five years.

item.title: Grass sai em defesa de Lula e sugere diálogo com FGC para salvar o BRB
item.description: Leandro Grass (PT) defended Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and criticized Governor Celina Leão regarding the BRB crisis, proposing dialogue with the Credit Guarantee Fund and the Central Bank to prevent privatization. He also presented proposals to reduce public health waiting times in the Federal District.

item.title: Campanha de Flávio evita confronto com Bolsa Família e mira debate fiscal
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign avoids direct confrontation over Lula's 15.04% raise in Bolsa Família, choosing instead to shift the debate toward efficient social program management and proposals for economic autonomy of beneficiaries, such as training and employment.

item.title: Lula diz não aceitar classificação de facções como terroristas: 'Terrorismo foi o 8 de Janeiro'
item.description: Lula rejected the US designation of PCC and CV as terrorists, claiming terrorism was January 8th and Bolsonaro's coup plotting. He stated that Trump and others confuse power struggles with state terrorism.

item.title: Contra ‘espuma’ do STF, Lula tem de falar do futuro e focar nos indecisos, diz José Genoino
item.description: José Genoino states that Lula should focus on the future and expose Flávio Bolsonaro's scandals to win undecided voters. He criticizes the Supreme Court crisis and advocates for justice reform, proposing term limits for ministers. The campaign should intensify social media and in-person outreach.

item.title: Crusoé: Lula diz que sempre foi contra GLO que ele decretou e prorrogou
item.description: Lula stated he has always opposed the GLO, which he himself decreed and extended in 2023, revealing a contradiction during an interview with Tupi radio. His stance faces criticism for inconsistency.

item.title: A interferência de Gilmar Mendes nas eleições em PE
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Gilmar Mendes has kept under investigation a case opened by the Pernambuco State Public Ministry that may affect the image of former mayor João Campos, a candidate for Pernambuco state government. The suspension of the investigation since February raises questions about potential judicial interference in the state elections.

item.title: Aumento do Bolsa Família: populismo fiscal com efeito eleitoral duvidoso
item.description: Columnist Fernando Schüler criticizes Lula's 15% Bolsa Família increase announced 17 days before elections, calling it fiscal populism without predictability. He highlights public debt growth from 71.7% to 82.5% of GDP and deficit above 9%, warning about the fiscal impact of the electoral measure.

item.title: Timing de operação contra Milton Leite pode ter poupado candidaturas dos filhos de contestação
item.description: The police operation against PCC in São Paulo, which includes former councilman Milton Leite as a fugitive, may have spared the electoral campaigns of his sons Alexandre Leite and Milton Leite Jr., who are running for seats in the São Paulo state legislature and the Chamber of Deputies under União Brasil.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro repete estratégia do pai e recruta ‘fiscais’ para eleições
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro announced the creation of a supporter network to monitor the 2026 elections, replicating the strategy used by his father, Jair Bolsonaro, in 2022. The initiative includes a website for registrations and training for credentialed volunteers to oversee polling stations and prevent irregularities. Despite unproven allegations of electoral fraud, the action aims to mobilize supporters for election observation.

item.title: Defesa de Vorcaro pede revogação da prisão e cita impasse no STF
item.description: The defense of former banker Daniel Vorcaro requested the revocation of his preventive imprisonment, asking for substitution with precautionary measures such as house arrest and electronic ankle bracelet. Lawyers point to a stalemate over the case rapporteur at the STF, after Justice Alexandre de Moraes accused colleague André Mendonça of abuse of authority. The process remains stalled, with the defense arguing that the imprisonment cannot be indefinitely extended due to the institutional deadlock.

item.title: Lula foi alvo de 1 em cada 4 conteúdos com IA publicados na pré-campanha, diz levantamento
item.description: A survey by the Observatory AI in Elections revealed that President Lula (PT) was the main target of AI-generated content during the pre-campaign, with 112 cases of artificial reproduction of his image or voice. This accounts for approximately 25% of all AI-related content identified during the period.

item.title: Presidenciáveis prometem impulsionar setor elétrico sem priorizar transição energética
item.description: Presidential candidates are avoiding prioritizing energy transition in their campaigns, despite the pressure following the Ormuz crisis. Only Lula and Caiado mention decarbonization goals. Lula proposes domestic mineral processing and taxing raw mineral exports to strengthen national industry.

item.title: Bolsa Família reforça agenda de benefícios de Lula e retoma comparação com Bolsonaro em 2022
item.description: President Lula announced an increase in the Bolsa Família benefit from R$ 600 to R$ 691, strengthening his social agenda ahead of the 2026 elections. Unlike Bolsonaro in 2022, who used a constitutional amendment to expand benefits, Lula funds the increase through reallocated budget resources. The package also includes fuel subsidies worth an estimated R$ 5.8 billion in 2026.

item.title: Lula diz que 5 ministros do STF estão envolvidos com Master e avalia que crise respinga na eleição
item.description: Lula accuses five Supreme Court justices of involvement in the Banco Master scandal and warns the crisis could affect the 2026 election. He praises Moraes for his electoral role but criticises judicial deals with Banco Master.

item.title: Lula afirma que há 5 ministros do STF ligados ao caso Master
item.description: President Lula claimed that five Supreme Court justices are linked to the Banco Master case without naming them. He used the statement to advocate for judicial reform, accusing justices of indirect involvement and blaming the Bolsonaro administration. The case involves contracts by the wife of Justice Alexandre de Moraes and ties between Justice Dias Toffoli and individuals connected to Banco Master.

item.title: Lula cita orgias e afirma que muita gente teme vazamentos do Master
item.description: President Lula stated in an interview that there are fears of leaks regarding the Master case, alleging that former banker Daniel Vorcaro funded 'orgies' and corrupted authorities, including Supreme Court justices, deputies, and senators. According to Lula, Banco Master was created during Bolsonaro's administration and would involve a misappropriation of 60 billion reais with alleged fraudulent operations in securities. He advocates opening all secrets to investigate the case fully before enacting any judicial reform.

item.title: ‘Eles criaram um banqueiro e eu o tornei prisioneiro’, diz Lula sobre Vorcaro
item.description: President Lula stated in an interview with Rádio Tupi that the Bolsonaro family enabled Daniel Vorcaro, the former owner of Banco Master, to rise, and that he was arrested during his administration. Lula also linked the case to Flávio Bolsonaro and emphasized that the Banco Master investigations will be leveraged in the final stretch of the campaign.
